detailed_descriptions.en: Frontier Tale is an extraction adventure where you explore, fight, and bring resources home to build your settlement, grow crops, brew drinks, and raise livestock. Play as Roland, a pioneer who ventures into the wilderness with his grandfather’s backing and his battle maid, Mia, at his side. Explore different maps, recruit companions, and turn a patch of wilderness into a thriving settlement of your own, one expedition at a time. 【GAME FEATURES】 Every Extraction Is Different Over 60 bosses , big and small, await. Each trip into the forest brings random boss encounters and unexpected events. Take up a weapon you forged yourself, fight your way through enemies, and search for building materials and rare treasures. Do you push a little farther for more loot, or head back while you can? Whatever you find, you’ll need to make it back to the village in one piece. A Wide Variety of Weapons Choose from over 90 weapons , some with unique charged moves. The Goblin Priest’s Axe can lock onto enemies while charging, the Radiant Crystal Sword fires a crystal beam when charged, and the Hymn of the Flame Demon sets enemies in front of you ablaze. Pick a weapon that feels right and head out! Build Your Dream Settlement Use the resources you bring home to build a village from the ground up. Put up workshops and warehouses, process materials, and craft equipment for your next expedition. As the village grows, your companions will live and work in the home you’ve built together, bringing the forgotten settlement back to life. Recruit Companions and Build Bonds As your territory expands, you’ll meet over 20 NPC companions . There’s a young mercenary who’s scared of bunnies, a carpenter with a mysterious past, a knight with some peculiar fighting habits, and plenty more. Each has their own combat style and specialty. Recruit them to fight by your side and help run the village. Back home, there are crops to plant, fields to water, ore to mine, and resources to gather. A Cozy, Cel-Style World Don’t let the bright colors fool you! The world looks like it came straight out of a fairy-tale picture book, but things can get tense fast when you’re trying to get out of the forest with a pack full of loot. Set Your Own Adventure Difficulty In the mood for a relaxed outing or a hardcore challenge? Pick a difficulty that suits you. Each setting changes how much risk you’ll face on your expedition. Ready for one more run?
